## Connect it

**The easy way (LP 1.0.2 and later):** open LP, go to **Settings → General → LP with Claude**, click
**Copy Setup Command**, paste it in Terminal and press Return. Then start a new Claude Code session.
The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

**The easy way (LP 1.0.2 and later):** open LP, go to **Settings → General → LP with Claude**, click
**Copy Setup Command**, paste it in Terminal and press Return. Then start a new Claude Code session.
The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

## Connect it

**The easy way (LP 1.0.2 and later):** open LP, go to **Settings → General → LP with Claude**, click
**Copy Setup Command**, paste it in Terminal and press Return. Then start a new Claude Code session.
The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```

The command connects Claude Code to the workspace LP has open, using the helper inside LP.app
(`/Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp`), and clears the flag macOS puts on downloaded
programs so the helper may run. LP's in-app updates keep the helper up to date.

**By hand** — Claude Code, for every project (`--scope user`; one `--workspace` per folder Claude
may ever be offered):

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add --scope user lp -- /Applications/LP.app/Contents/Helpers/lp-mcp \
  --workspace "/path/to/your LP folder" --workspace "/path/to/another one"
claude mcp list                       # lp: ✓ Connected
```
